extraction_notes: Reaction conditions H2/N2 = 3:1 and space velocity = 72 000 mL h−1 gcat−1 are stated once in the Experimental section and applied to activity records unless a record-specific source states otherwise. Figure 1a values other than those printed in Table 1/text are approximate visual readings. Figure 1d time-course points were not digitized because many small points are closely spaced and not individually labelled; the paper states qualitatively that Co@BaO/MgO-700red remained stable for 200 h at 350 °C and 1.0 MPa. Supporting Information tables/figures are referenced but not provided in the input, so only values printed in the main text were extracted from them.
